hook: A cargo plane, low over a burning ridge, on purpose.
narration: This military cargo plane flew low over a California wildfire, right through the smoke.
A California Air National Guard crew followed a Forest Service lead plane down toward the Long Fire.
Their C-130J carried a system that can drop three thousand gallons of retardant in under ten seconds.
The lead plane flies the line first, [short pause] so the tanker crew knows exactly where to drop.
outcome: The Guard crew made its retardant drop over the Long Fire in Tulare County.
title: C-130 flies low over a wildfire
description:
A California Air National Guard C-130J crew followed a U.S. Forest Service lead plane to drop fire retardant on the Long Fire in Tulare County, California, on July 17, 2024.

Footage: U.S. Air National Guard video by Tech. Sgt. Richard Guiterrez and Tech. Sgt. John Toledo, 115th Airlift Squadron, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/930973/california-air-national-guard-aerial-fire-fighting-c-130j-drops-retardant-long-fire
